criteria.title: Create first report with remaining codes available
criteria.blocker: No Service Request with an Activity Definition defining multiple diagnostic report codes exists in the test environment. Fixtures lack Activity Definitions with multiple diagnostic_report_codes.

criteria.title: Already-used codes are removed from dropdown
criteria.blocker: Requires a Service Request with one diagnostic report already created, which requires Service Requests with Activity Definitions that have multiple diagnostic_report_codes. This test data does not exist in fixtures.

criteria.title: Multiple reports show all unused codes
criteria.blocker: Requires a Service Request with 2 out of 3 diagnostic reports already created. Cannot reach this state without the foundational test data (Activity Definitions with multiple codes and Service Requests using them).

criteria.title: All codes used disables creation
criteria.blocker: Requires a Service Request where all diagnostic report codes have been used (3 out of 3 reports created). Cannot reach this state without the foundational test data infrastructure.

criteria.title: Navigate away and return shows correct state
criteria.blocker: Requires existing Service Requests with partial diagnostic reports created (2 out of 3). Cannot test state persistence without first having the required Service Requests and diagnostic reports.

criteria.title: Service Request without diagnostic report codes unchanged
criteria.blocker: Requires a Service Request with an Activity Definition that has no diagnostic_report_codes defined. While simpler than multi-code ADs, still requires Service Request creation infrastructure which is not available in fixtures.

criteria.title: Sequential creation without reload
criteria.blocker: Requires ability to create multiple diagnostic reports sequentially, which first requires Service Requests with Activity Definitions that have multiple diagnostic_report_codes. Cannot test sequential flow without foundational test data.
